items.name: See where your money goes
items.text: Usage per project, environment and resource, day by day, with a CSV export.

items.name: Deploys that say why they're stuck
items.text: If your app never gets ready, Lucity tells you, down to the port nothing listens on.

items.name: Deploy one app from a monorepo
items.text: Lucity lists the apps it finds in your repository and you pick the one to deploy.

items.name: Custom domains behind a proxy
items.text: Keep your DNS provider's proxy on. Your domain still verifies and gets its certificate.

items.name: A log explorer
items.text: Search by keyword, go back up to 14 days and filter by instance, including ones that already crashed.

items.name: A canvas that updates live
items.text: Deploys, scaling and new resources show up within a second. No reload.

items.name: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
items.text: One palette for every project, environment and resource.
